# `vox-redact`

**Crate:** `vox-redact` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Regex-based redaction of secrets and PII from log lines and JSON values.

## Crate Overview

Conservative PII/secret redaction. Moved from `vox-terminal-core::corpus::redact`
so non-terminal crates (e.g. agent operation capture) can reuse it without a
backwards dependency edge.

Redaction is conservative: unknown patterns are left as-is. Only patterns with
high precision (low false-positive rate) are elided.


## Public API Surface

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `redact_owned` | Redact PII/secret patterns in free text. Conservative: unknown patterns pass through. |
| `redact_args` | Recursively redact a JSON value: values under secret-ish keys become `"[REDACTED]"`; all other string scalars are run through [`redact_owned`]. |
